caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher rendered in shades of gray pencil on a plain, light background. The pitcher has a wide mouth with a spout on one side and a curved handle on the other. The body of the pitcher is ornate, featuring vertical ribbed patterns on the upper part and a combination of scrollwork and rounded, bead-like decorations on the lower part. The lines and shading suggest a reflective, possibly metallic or glass surface. The overall form of the pitcher is rounded and tapers slightly towards the base, with intricate details captured through careful use of light and shadow. There is a signature in the bottom left corner that reads “Fumagalli.”
title: Pitcher
